'''Watchtower Run''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course in the dense jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. It was located around the [[Tower of Eyes]], [[Fortress Mountain Arena]] and the [[Clutter Junkyard]]. The rainforest world was home to the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], who had made it impossible to visit their planet in the past. But since the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] hired the Gamorreans as guards and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], the Podracing community created racecourses there. Watchtower Run was the first of Gamorr's three Podraces, and the last course of the [[Galactic Trials]]. The [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] was the track favorite, and helmed most of the course's speed and knockout records during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
